candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Ego drives the same mission in Town01 while a linear-moving vehicle approaches from a slightly shifted position, creating a low-speed lateral or oblique collision ahead with ego still moving, valid waypoints, perceived objects, and no braking in the critical window.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Switch the primary colliding counterpart from a walker-dominated interaction to a vehicle-dominated one while still preserving the core symptom: collision under continued ego motion with active planning/perception and no braking, plus an ambiguous or inconsistent actuation command state. The slight spatial and speed adjustments increase the chance of collision without changing the fundamental command-vs-status ambiguity pattern.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Ensure actor_index 1 remains a vehicle with linear navigation whose trajectory intersects or closely approaches ego’s lane within the final segment of the route.
Verify that the mutated spawn and destination still keep ego on a comparable road segment in Town01, so that the vehicle actor can appear in ego’s forward field and be detectable by perception.
Confirm that both perception and prediction modules are active so that the approaching vehicle should appear in object and prediction topics before collision.
Check that no explicit emergency-brake trigger or scripted stop behavior is added for ego that would force strong braking before the interaction.
post_execution_validation_rules: Verify that ego is involved in at least one collision with the other vehicle (actor_index 1) or another nearby agent while ego speed remains nonzero and does not significantly decrease in the few seconds immediately before impact.
Check that ego’s brake status and brake command remain near zero or otherwise show lack of meaningful braking during the critical pre-collision window.
Confirm that final_waypoints are continuously available and unblocked (full set of waypoints) leading up to collision, indicating that the planner had a valid trajectory.
Ensure perception and prediction object topics contain at least one object in front or near ego (preferably the other vehicle) near the collision time.

Inspect vehicle_cmd versus vehicle_status to verify some form of ambiguous actuation behavior (e.g., zero accel/brake commands while ego remains under throttle and moving, or another inconsistency consistent with the original case).
Do not require lane_invasion presence or absence for run acceptance; collisions with or without lane invasion both satisfy the intended pattern.
uncertainty: It is not guaranteed that the colliding agent will be exactly actor_index 1; another nearby vehicle or object could become the primary collision partner depending on emergent behavior, as long as the core pattern is met.
The exact geometry (side-swipe vs frontal) of the vehicle-to-ego collision may vary; any collision under motion with no braking and valid waypoints is acceptable.
Whether the simulation reproduces the precise zeroed-command vs moving-vehicle mismatch is uncertain and must be verified by inspecting post-run logs.
